skill.name: sales-automator
skill.description: Draft cold emails, follow-ups, proposal templates, pricing copy, case studies, and sales scripts for lead nurturing.
skill.summary: Create sales outreach drafts, follow-up cadences, proposals, case studies, and objection handling scripts.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive caused by Markdown backticks around a resource path in SKILL.md. No prompt injection, data exfiltration, or business-logic abuse was found in the reviewed skill text.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 25 uses Markdown backticks around a resource file path, not Ruby or shell execution. The skill is prompt-only and contains no executable command path.

content.value_statement: Sales teams need clear outreach that is personalized, concise, and easy to test. This skill helps draft emails, follow-ups, proposals, case studies, scripts, and measurement plans.
actual_capabilities: Drafts 3 to 5 touchpoint cold email sequences.
Creates subject lines for A/B testing.
Builds personalization variables from provided prospect research.
Writes proposal and quote template copy.
Drafts case studies and social proof messaging.
Creates objection handling scripts and tracking metrics.
limitations: Does not send emails or connect to CRM systems.
Requires accurate product, audience, and prospect details.
Does not verify deliverability, inbox placement, or contact consent.
Sales copy may need legal and compliance review.

use_cases.title: Build a Cold Outreach Sequence
use_cases.description: Create a short email cadence with subject lines, personalization variables, and one clear call to action.

use_cases.title: Prepare Proposal Messaging
use_cases.description: Turn offer details into proposal copy, pricing page language, and customer proof points.

use_cases.title: Improve Lead Nurture Content
use_cases.description: Draft follow-up messages, objection responses, and test ideas for prospects not ready to buy.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic Outreach Email
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one prospect segment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a concise cold email for [target audience]. Include one value point, one proof point, and one clear meeting request.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Follow-Up Cadence
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a multi-touch sequence.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 5 touch follow-up cadence for [offer]. Include timing, subject lines, personalization variables, and a different angle for each message.

prompt_templates.title: Write Proposal and Objection Copy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for deal support materials.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build proposal copy for [buyer persona]. Include problem framing, offer summary, pricing rationale, proof points, and responses to three likely objections.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Outreach Test Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an A/B test plan for [campaign goal]. Include hypotheses, subject line variants, success metrics, audience segments, and follow-up decisions.

output_examples.input: A founder needs outreach for finance leaders at mid-market software companies.
output: A 4 email sequence focused on cost control and reporting speed.
Eight subject lines grouped by pain point and business outcome.
Personalization fields for role, company trigger, and current finance workflow.
Metrics to track reply rate, booked meetings, and objection themes.

output_examples.input: An account executive needs proposal language for a workflow automation deal.
output: A proposal summary that links automation to reduced manual work.
Pricing page copy that explains value before plan details.
Three objection responses about implementation time, adoption, and budget.
A customer proof section using the provided case study details.

output_examples.input: A marketing team wants to revive stalled leads from a webinar list.
output: A nurture sequence that references the webinar topic and buyer pain.
Follow-up timing for the first two weeks after the event.
Soft calls to action for resource downloads and discovery calls.

best_practices: Provide buyer persona, offer details, proof points, and desired call to action.
Ask for short messages with one clear outcome per touchpoint.
Review drafts for consent, claims, brand voice, and regional compliance rules.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for deceptive personalization or false customer claims.
Do not send generated copy without checking accuracy and compliance.
Do not use one generic message for every prospect segment.

faq.question: Can this skill send emails for me?
faq.answer: No. It drafts content and plans, but it does not send messages or connect to sales tools.

faq.question: What inputs improve the output?
faq.answer: Provide audience details, offer value, proof points, prospect research, brand voice, and the desired call to action.

faq.question: Can it create a full cold email sequence?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft a 3 to 5 touchpoint sequence with subject lines and follow-up timing.

faq.question: Does it support proposal writing?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft proposal sections, quote language, pricing page copy, and case study messaging.

faq.question: Can it help with A/B testing?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest subject line variants, message angles, hypotheses, and metrics to monitor.

faq.question: Is the generated copy compliance ready?
faq.answer: No. Review all outreach for consent rules, legal claims, privacy requirements, and company policy.
